frame: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production hand-painted mobile game popup outer frame, text-free reusable art. Reference image 1 is the approved player-progress popup; image 2 is the sibling leaderboard. Recreate their same illustrated honey-brown carved wooden rectangular noticeboard frame, warm ivory paper interior, leafy top corners and small polished gold corner screws, raised long brick-red ribbon centred over top rail. Keep warm gouache brushstrokes, distinct deep greens, honey gold glints. REMOVE ALL text, numbers, avatar, inside panels, islands, symbols, close/back buttons, flower ornaments on header, interior lines. The entire interior is empty uninterrupted lightly textured cream paper. Preserve distinct natural hand-carved shape with gently bowed top rail and green leaves in top left/right, small leaves bottom corners; straight vertical side rails so centre can stretch. Ribbon blank readable central span at least 65% of fullwidth, NO writing. Board ratio about 2:3 (1024 by 1536). Generous 24px transparent margin outside complete silhouette, all corners uncut. Authentic fully transparent RGBA outside board, NOT checkerboard or white backdrop. Natural thin shadow restricted close to frame. Only this single empty frame, no sprite sheet, no UI overlay. Important: no cross, no button, no text or Chinese anywhere.
parts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production text-free UI sprite sheet for a warm hand-painted mobile game matching reference image 1. Transparent background, neatly separated isolated objects, no white/checkerboard. Arrange 6 items with wide blank transparent gutters for cropping, in THREE ROWS x TWO COLUMNS, no contact between items. TOP LEFT: one wide asymmetric dark forestgreen wooden score plaque with burnished gold rim, slight carved curved corners, a tiny leaf at bottomright, approximately 3:1 aspect ratio. TOP RIGHT: one long narrow forestgreen gold-rimmed category sign with two small leaves at left, 4:1 aspect ratio. MIDDLE LEFT: honey-gold oval hanging fraction tag, 2:1 aspect ratio, two short green loops emerging from top, clear blank centre. MIDDLE RIGHT: one small long golden LEAF-SHAPED rank badge with green leafsprig at left and polished brass fastener, 2.3:1 ratio, blank centre. BOTTOM LEFT: green active tab background, rounded uneven top and flat bottom with a little foldedleaf on left edge, 3:1 ratio. BOTTOM RIGHT: matching pale warm ivory inactive tab with wooden gold thin edging, 3:1 ratio. All painterly gouache textures, carved wood/gold material, darkgreen highcontrast surfaces against transparent surroundings. NO text, letters, numbers, coins, flower emblem, icons or symbols in any centre. No mockup board or paper backdrop. Match exact visual family of reference: cosy hand painted rich deepgreens/golden carvedwood.
islands: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: THREE production isometric hand-painted game map islands, transparent cutouts, referencing islands in image 1. Output wide landscape sprite sheet (1536x1024), one row of three fully separated islands, each around 420x420px with large transparent gutters. LEFT island: tall mountains, forest, river and waterfall, little woodenbridge, shrubs and redflowers; CENTRE island: cosy public plaza with fountain, small townhall, stone arched bridge, pathways, lampposts and trees; RIGHT island: house, school with tinyflag, low-rise office, playground runningtrack, dock, surrounding trees. Each has its OWN completely separated irregular grassy island coastline, rocky shore and small shallow turquoise waterhalo, NO rectangular panel. Same visual family and isometric perspective as reference, storybook gouache with painterly details, golden daylight, deepgreen trees, honeywhite walls and warm terracotta roofs. ALL THREE FULLY COLORED THROUGHOUT. NO fog, no white unfinished/grayscale portions, no progress markers, no signs, no numbers, no text, no title or UI. Waterhalos remain separated by truly transparent alpha. Floating island silhouettes NOT connected. Neat production PNG transparent RGBA outside islands, no white or checkerboard background.
avatar: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone game avatar sprite, transparent RGBA background. Use image 1 only as palette and handpainted style reference. NEW DIFFERENT RED FLOWER CHARACTER, not the crossed-arm avatar in reference. A charmingly smug, humorous cheeky redflower with compact five plump scarlet petals framing a golden-yellow face. One green leafhand pinches the corner of TINY BLACK SUNGLASSES and pulls them halfway down the nose, revealing half-lidded sideways eyes and one raised asymmetrical eyebrow; other leafhand cocked at hip. Tiny closed crooked grin, knowing 'really?' smirk, no open mouth or scary teeth. Head angled slightly, cocky but adorable. A few small leafy collar shapes below head, NO human body or arms. Clear silhouette suitable for a 68px icon, expressive face large and readable. Rich warm gouache painting and visible soft brushstrokes, consistent with forestgreen/honeygold/cream/red reference UI, NOT plastic 3D, not flat emoji. One isolated character centred with generous transparent margins, every petal and leaf tip inside frame, no background, no frame, no text. Do not reuse crossed-arm pose. Genuine transparent alpha, no checkerboard. Square image.
